mintAuthority.summary: VBILL is a Securitize-administered fund token with issuer-native issuance surfaces on Ethereum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, and Solana. The three EVM DSToken proxies expose owner-gated issueTokens and UUPS upgrade paths controlled by the same EOA 0x59c1eA...76Ee; the Solana Token-2022 mint and freeze authorities are issuer-controlled by BJXUcHs7...cgiK. These are native issuance controls, not Wormhole Guardian or transfer-admin controls. The Solana mint-program upgrade path remains unresolved.

controls.label: VBILL Securitize DSToken issuance surface
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081, owner() returned 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee (unchanged from block 25166611). Implementation 0xaf88485377cca5e690e7dcb1ba81370f0b575156 confirmed. Source identifies issueTokens and issueTokensWithNoCompliance as mint entry points gated by the owner.

controls.label: VBILL Securitize DSToken issuance surface (Avalanche)
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 92972905, owner() returned the shared EOA 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee and the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xc7579a9a4801a805b66742e5bd56a1581705fe0d. The verified Securitize DSToken model exposes owner-gated issueTokens and issueTokensWithNoCompliance, so this is an issuer-native issuance surface rather than a Wormhole controller.

controls.evidence: At BNB Chain block 116336111, owner() returned the shared EOA 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee and the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xcd01d1c5c78ad428cd01913d4664c20ed1e61923. The verified Securitize DSToken model exposes owner-gated issueTokens and issueTokensWithNoCompliance, so this is an issuer-native issuance surface rather than a Wormhole controller.

controls.label: VBILL Solana Token-2022 mint authority
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 439710513, the VBILL Token-2022 mint 34mJztT9am2jybSukvjNqRjgJBZqHJsHnivArx1P4xy1 had mintAuthority and freezeAuthority set to BJXUcHs7R8m9oxzQkFxphZUXMY8SPsK8uPi5Sx7ycgiK. The authority is issuer-controlled in the reviewed route, but its key-versus-program governance and any upgrade authority remain unresolved.

controls.label: VBILL token owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770003, Avalanche block 92972905, and BNB Chain block 116336111, owner() returned the same code-empty EOA 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee. The verified Securitize DSToken model gates issueTokens and UUPS authorization through the owner; off-chain MPC/HSM custody is indistinguishable from the EOA read.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081: owner() confirmed returning EOA 0x59c1eA...76Ee; eth_getCode confirms EOA (no bytecode). DSToken source confirms mint is gated by owner. Re-verified 2026-08-16 at Ethereum block 25770003 (implementation 0xaf88485377cca5e690e7dcb1ba81370f0b575156), Avalanche block 92972905 (implementation 0xc7579a9a4801a805b66742e5bd56a1581705fe0d), and BNB Chain block 116336111 (implementation 0xcd01d1c5c78ad428cd01913d4664c20ed1e61923): all three owner() reads returned the same code-empty EOA 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee. At Solana slot 439710513, the Token-2022 mint 34mJztT9am2jybSukvjNqRjgJBZqHJsHnivArx1P4xy1 had mintAuthority and freezeAuthority BJXUcHs7R8m9oxzQkFxphZUXMY8SPsK8uPi5Sx7ycgiK. The Solana mint authority is recorded, but its controlling program or governance and any mint-program upgrade authority remain unresolved. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: VBILL publishes Securitize-administered daily NAV through RedStone and identifies State Street as custodian, but no dated independent fund supply-to-assets attestation was found. The BVI FSC registry matches VanEck Treasury Fund, Ltd. as a professional fund, so supervision is established while reconciliation remains unknown. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: the issuer owner can mint and upgrade without a delay or firm cap across the three EVM deployments, the Solana mint has no reviewed supply cap, daily NAV does not reconcile whole multi-chain token supply to fund assets, and the BVI FSC registry names the supervised professional fund product.
